popupExpandToggleTip: Inner scrollable panels and iframe frames are stretched to their whole content before being captured, instead of being photographed the way they are visible. For frames from other websites the browser asks once for a further permission.
optionsLead: Changes are saved automatically and are synchronised with your browser profile.
optionsExpandPermGranted: Permission granted — frames from other websites are unfolded as well.
optionsExpandPermMissing: Without the "read all websites" permission, frames from other websites are captured the way they are visible. Panels and frames from the same website always work.
optionsRedactPIIDesc: Searches the text the page exposes and finds e-mails, telephone numbers, payment card numbers, birth numbers and API keys; in the saved image it then covers with a solid area what matched. It cannot read text rendered as pixels — a canvas, an image, a PDF, a video frame. The recognition runs in your device; nothing is ever sent anywhere. Applies to captures of the whole page (document scroll); the covering is permanent, so check the result yourselves.
scrollclipFormatHint: GIF you can play everywhere. WebM is smaller and smoother (it is recorded live directly in your browser).
batchPermissionHint: Opening these pages will ask for a one-off permission at the first run.
batchPermissionDeclined: The permission to open these pages was refused.
redactActsNone: The blacking out found nothing in the read text and painted no block. Nothing is outlined below.
redactActsShortfall: The blacking out found 3 and covered 2.
redactActsUncoveredOne: 1 match is not covered in this image.
redactActsUncoveredOther: 2 matches are not covered in this image.
reviewLimit: FullShot reads the text that the page makes accessible. It cannot see this image. Nothing drawn as pixels – canvas, image, PDF page, video frame – was ever read.
reviewNoMarks: No blocks are outlined in the image below.
